name: Peninsula Gardens | 0.5g Live Rosin Disposable | Bomb Sauce
description: Using devices from O2 vape, the rosin that doesn’t make it into our jars goes into our vapes. Most companies would still call this their top shelf material and use it for jars but we wanted to bring the best possible vapes to the market. Terpene preservation is of the upmost importance to us when it comes to cartridges. Flavor is just like it would be from your dab rig and the high is extremely balanced unlike distillate vapes.
